en.title: Less to read. More to grasp.
en.subtitle: The model carries the work and shapes what reaches the person
observation: Output can create work for the reader
Redundant prose and irrelevant details add reading, sorting and recall.
choices: Show a concrete result|the person can inspect
test: Results and meaningful choices are visible; detail is available when needed.
en.return: Use the next task to improve how we present
en.retire: The model maintains the supporting work and full evidence.
en.description: Model output can impose reading, sorting and recall. Prefer visuals to text, clarity to complexity and intuition to formalism. Show results and meaningful choices while the model maintains supporting work and evidence. Actual use improves later output and interfaces.

zh-CN.title: 少读冗余，更快看懂
zh-CN.subtitle: 模型承担工作，也负责选择什么呈现给人
observation: 模型输出也在制造认知复杂性
冗余文字与无关细节，让人额外阅读、筛选和记忆。
zh-CN.allocation: 重新设计用户看到的内容
choices: 留下当前判断需要的内容
直接呈现可理解的结果
test: 人能够看懂，并继续自己的活动
结果与重要选择直接可见；需要细节时，再从原处展开。
zh-CN.return: 用实际使用，改进下一次呈现的方法
zh-CN.retire: 模型维护背后的实现、完整材料与核验。
zh-CN.description: 模型输出中的冗余文字和无关细节制造额外的阅读、筛选和记忆。以图大于文字、清晰大于复杂、直观大于形式组织呈现，让人看见结果与重要选择，模型维护背后的实现与证据，再从实际使用改进下一次呈现的方法。
